claims: C1: Tokens are atomic units of text or multimodal data
C2: Tokens are used to measure the length of model inputs and outputs
C3: Messages are converted into a sequence of tokens before being passed into the model
C4: Models have a fixed maximum number of tokens they can input or output in a single request

concepts.name: token_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a token: an atomic unit of text or multimodal data used to measure the length of model inputs and outputs

concepts.name: atomic_unit
concepts.inference: The clause characterizes tokens as 'atomic units', presupposing that such units can be identified and distinguished

concepts.name: multimodal_data
concepts.gloss: T is multimodal data, combining text with other modalities

concepts.name: message_token_conversion
concepts.gloss: message M is converted into tokens T before being passed into the model

concepts.name: model_max_tokens
concepts.gloss: Model M has a maximum of N tokens it can input or output in a single request

ontology.gloss: T is an atomic unit of text
T is an atomic unit of multimodal data, such as a word or piece of a word
